lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਪੀੜ ॥
lines.transliteration: paunai paanee aganee jeeu tin kiaa khuseeaa kiaa peeR ||
lines.translation: Living beings are formed of air, water and fire. They are subject to pleasure and pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਵਜੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharatee paataalee aakaasee ik dar rahan vajeer ||
lines.translation: In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic ethers of the heavens, some remain ministers in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਹੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa vadee aarajaa ik mar hohi jaheer ||
lines.translation: Some live long lives, while others suffer and die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦੇ ਖਾਹਿ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਕੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik de khaahi nikhutai naahee ik sadaa phirahi phakeer ||
lines.translation: Some give and consume, and still their wealth is not exhausted, while others remain poor forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਾਹੇ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਲਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukamee saaje hukamee dhaahe ek chase mahi lakh ||
lines.translation: In His Will He creates, and in His Will He destroys thousands in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਥੈ ਨਥਿਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਤੋੜੇ ਨਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko nathai nathiaa bakhase toRe nath ||
lines.translation: He has harnessed everyone with His harness; when He forgives, he breaks the harness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਲੇਖੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਅਲਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa lekhe baajh alakh ||
lines.translation: He has no color or features; He is invisible and beyond calculation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu katheeai kiu aakheeai jaapai sacho sach ||
lines.translation: How can He be described? He is known as the Truest of the True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਾ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਾਰ ਸਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanaa kathanaa kaar sabh naanak aap akath ||
lines.translation: All the actions which are done and described, O Nanak, are done by the Indescribable Lord Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: akath kee kathaa sunei ||
lines.translation: Whoever hears the description of the indescribable,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ridh budh sidh giaan sadaa sukh hoi ||1||
lines.translation: is blessed with wealth, intelligence, perfection, spiritual wisdom and eternal peace. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਤ ਨਉ ਕੁਲ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajar jarai ta nau kul ba(n)dh ||
lines.translation: One who bears the unbearable, controls the nine holes of the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: poojai praan hovai thir ka(n)dh ||
lines.translation: One who worships and adores the Lord with his breath of life, gains stability in his body-wall.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਹਾਂ ਏਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa(n) te aaiaa kahaa(n) ehu jaan ||
lines.translation: Where has he come from, and where will he go?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marat rahai paravaan ||
lines.translation: Remaining dead while yet alive, he is accepted and approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukamai boojhai tat pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: Whoever understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, realizes the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu parasaad guroo te jaanai ||
lines.translation: This is known by Guru's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਂਦਾ ਫੜੀਅਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ho(n)daa phaReeag naanak jaan ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, know this: egotism leads to bondage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naa hau naa mai joonee paan ||2||
lines.translation: Only those who have no ego and no self-conceit, are not consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜੑੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਹੋਰਿ ਬੁਧਂੀ ਮਿਥਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paRheeai naam saalaah hor budha(n)ee mithiaa ||
lines.translation: Read the Praise of the Lord's Name; other intellectual pursuits are false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sache vaapaar janam birathiaa ||
lines.translation: Without dealing in Truth, life is worthless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t na paaraavaar na kin hee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: No one has ever found the Lord's end or limitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਗਰਬਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag garab gubaar tin sach na bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: All the world is enveloped by the darkness of egotistical pride. It does not like the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਤਾਵਣਿ ਤਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chale naam visaar taavan tatiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who depart from this world, forgetting the Naam, shall be roasted in the frying pan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baladee a(n)dar tel dubidhaa ghatiaa ||
lines.translation: They pour the oil of duality within, and burn.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਉਠੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਉਵਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaiaa uthee khel phirai uvatiaa ||
lines.translation: They come into the world and wander around aimlessly; they depart when the play is finished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachai mel sachai ratiaa ||24||
lines.translation: O Nanak, imbued with Truth, the mortals merge in Truth. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਮਾਸੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa(n) maasahu ni(n)miaa maasai a(n)dar vaas ||
lines.translation: First, the mortal is conceived in the flesh, and then he dwells in the flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਸੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਡੁ ਚੰਮੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu paai maas muhi miliaa had cha(n)m tan maas ||
lines.translation: When he comes alive, his mouth takes flesh; his bones, skin and body are flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਢਿਆ ਮੰਮਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maasahu baahar kadhiaa ma(n)maa maas giraas ||
lines.translation: He comes out of the womb of flesh, and takes a mouthful of flesh at the breast.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹੁ ਮਾਸੈ ਕਾ ਜੀਭ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੀ ਮਾਸੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: muhu maasai kaa jeebh maasai kee maasai a(n)dar saas ||
lines.translation: His mouth is flesh, his tongue is flesh; his breath is in the flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ ਵੀਆਹਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaa hoaa veeaahiaa ghar lai aaiaa maas ||
lines.translation: He grows up and is married, and brings his wife of flesh into his home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਾਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maasahu hee maas oopajai maasahu sabho saak ||
lines.translation: Flesh is produced from flesh; all relatives are made of flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai hukam bujheeai taa(n) ko aavai raas ||
lines.translation: When the mortal meets the True Guru, and realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then he comes to be reformed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਚਨਿ ਬਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhute nah chhooteeai naanak bachan binaas ||1||
lines.translation: Releasing himself, the mortal does not find release; O Nanak, through empty words, one is ruined. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਝਗੜੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maas maas kar moorakh jhagaRe giaan dhiaan nahee jaanai ||
lines.translation: The fools argue about flesh and meat, but they know nothing about meditation and spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਸਾਗੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun maas kaun saag kahaavai kis mahi paap samaane ||
lines.translation: What is called meat, and what is called green vegetables? What leads to sin?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੈਂਡਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਕੀਏ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gai(n)daa maar hom jag keee devatiaa kee baane ||
lines.translation: It was the habit of the gods to kill the rhinoceros, and make a feast of the burnt offering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਨਕੁ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maas chhod bais nak pakaRahi raatee maanas khaane ||
lines.translation: Those who renounce meat, and hold their noses when sitting near it, devour men at night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੋ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: phaR kar lokaa(n) no dikhalaavahi giaan dhiaan nahee soojhai ||
lines.translation: They practice hypocrisy, and make a show before other people, but they do not understand anything about meditation or spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak a(n)dhe siu kiaa kaheeai kahai na kahiaa boojhai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, what can be said to the blind people? They cannot answer, or even understand what is said.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhaa soi j a(n)dh kamaavai tis ridai s lochan naahee ||
lines.translation: They alone are blind, who act blindly. They have no eyes in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਕਤੁ ਨਿਪੰਨੇ ਮਛੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਖਾਂਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa kee rakat nipa(n)ne machhee maas na khaa(n)hee ||
lines.translation: They are produced from the blood of their mothers and fathers, but they do not eat fish or meat.
